description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across layers for four different en&X configurations, where X represents en, es, el, and bn. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to 22 with integer tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Similarity,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.45 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The brown line, representing “en&en,” starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6, then declines steadily to about 0.07 at layer 22. The blue line, “en&es,” begins near 0.05, rises to approximately 0.24 at layer 6, then gradually declines to about 0.04 at layer 22. The green line, “en&el,” starts near 0.04, rises to approximately 0.15 at layer 6, then declines to about 0.04 at layer 22. The purple line, “en&bn,” begins near 0.03, rises to approximately 0.14 at layer 6, then declines to about 0.04 at layer 22. All lines are solid with circular markers and show similar overall trends, with the “en&en” line consistently having the highest similarity values across the entire layer range.
